author: reek
body: Runtime probe for the widened syscall capability surface: every block syscall consults the per-process capability word before driving the device. The program declares Device.Block, so the boot grant derived from its own manifest includes the block-device bit and the first sector count succeeds (0 with no disk attached). It then strips its own grant word in the process table and asks again. The kernel refuses with -1 without touching the device.
